tests.initial_compile_correction: The first standalone checker referenced a nonexistent CityHistory.note getter. Changed validation to actual public catalog/identity/revision/latest APIs before passing checks.

implementation.scope: Typed immutable city and optional city-history bytes in private world/library envelope v3; outer private generation frame remains v2. No arbitrary filenames/paths, structure-package contents or production save changes. Offline metadata is required when sidecars are attached.
implementation.bounds: 4 MiB combined sidecar bytes plus 20 framing bytes; existing 16 MiB whole generation payload limit still applies. This diagnostic sidecar cap is below the existing CityHistory 64 MiB maximum: larger valid files reject rather than truncate.
implementation.integrity: Check known city format magic1..17; history magic/version, 64-byte SHA-256 fingerprint of exact city bytes, and stored CRC32. Own envelope uses bounded lengths and CRC. Copy source/getter bytes. City/history bodies are not semantically validated by this envelope.
implementation.publication: Optional root sidecars survive later geometry commits and restart. Synthetic updates change source-root identity; stale stages reject. A store stage cannot omit existing sidecars. Actual ordinary game city saves, source-file discovery and coordinated legacy multi-file restoration are not integrated.

fixture_provenance: CitySimulation generated a synthetic city sidecar and its bound history; actual sizes 39949 and 239147 bytes. A synthetic LocalGame base file was imported alongside the pair and staged into private storage. All temporary source/restored files were removed. No real user, account or city files were read.
cases: Generated city/history bytes survive private import, generation publication, authority restart and a later geometry edit/save byte for byte
Restored CitySimulation.load equals the original frame; CityHistory.load retains nonempty catalog, identity, revision and latest time
Source arrays and returned arrays cannot mutate snapshots; absent history stays absent
Omitting existing sidecars rejects without changing generation bytes; changed sidecar root invalidates staged publication and retry preserves current state
Mismatched city/history fingerprint, damaged history CRC, unknown city magic, undersized history, over-budget content/envelope, truncated/trailing/corrupt envelopes reject
Offline metadata required for sidecar-bearing world envelope; pre/mid-cancel and thread interruption reject
Exactly 4 MiB prefix-only synthetic city bytes round-trip to test transport capacity. These bytes are deliberately not a valid semantic CityFrame and were not passed to the city loader
Original generated city/history/base source bytes remain unchanged; existing codecs, all offline formats and engine/private authority regressions pass

limitations: Sidecar envelope is a byte-preservation and binding check, not a semantic validator for arbitrary CityFrame/history bodies. Not connected to LocalGame/server persistence, automatic migration, source-file snapshot discovery, live simulation ownership or coordinated multi-file restoration. Server-player state, ordinary-edit persistence and persistent runtime undo remain pending. Synthetic updates are dirty until later publication.
